correctness.rationale: Independently checked the finite result by deleting the marked leaf, rather than by the frozen recursion. All parent arrays have equal mass. Deleting j when it is a final leaf and order-preservingly relabeling gives a bijection with pairs consisting of an arbitrary recursive tree of size n−1 and an attachment label in {1,…,j−1}; reversal inserts j as a leaf. Thus the event probability is (j−1)/(n−1), the residual tree is uniform, and all other depths are unchanged. The marked depth has its ordinary mean H_(j−1), since its parent law and the earlier tree are unaltered by the later exclusions. Using E[T_k]=k(H_k−1), obtained by the usual depth recursion, the conditional mean is (n−1)(H_(n−1)−1)+H_(j−1), which yields the stated covariance. For m=j−1 and N=n−1, the absolute covariance times N is F_N(m)=m(H_N−H_m), with forward difference H_N−H_m−1, strictly decreasing wherever two differences exist. Integral comparison gives a uniform error at most 1/N from (m/N)log(N/m), including the zero-age endpoint. This profile has a unique maximum at e⁻¹, so all maximizing sequences and the maximum converge as claimed. Exchanging the harmonic sums gives sum_m F_N(m)=N(N−1)/4. The cases j=n and n=2 (always a leaf) give zero covariance as required.
residual_risks: The deletion argument is used for a first moment, not to claim independence of total residual path length and the marked vertex's depth or a full conditional distribution.

evidence: The joint recursive-tree generating function retains total number of leaves, external path length and total path length, not the identity/birth label of a leaf. The relevant Hoppe-tree theorems cover separate marginals; the recursive-tree metric scaling example is not a conditional leaf result.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A result joint in unmarked totals determines aggregate moments but cannot recover a specific coordinate among nonexchangeable label ranks. Broader parameter coverage for marginals does not supply this joint moment.

evidence: The prior statistics give the covariance of total leaf count with path length; a separate marked result conditions instead on a root attachment. Path-length means from classical recursive-tree computations provide only the unconditioned part of the target formula.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The aggregate is prior and receives no originality credit. At fixed j one must identify what final leaf conditioning does to the other attachments, or equivalently perform the marked deletion argument. Neither the aggregate relation nor the distinct root mark supplies that identification in the inspected passages.

evidence: The November 2 Finding gives the same conditional-mean shift, local covariance and leading maximizing age. The other two comparison marks are leaf degree (number of leaf neighbors) and the arrival-j root attachment event.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The November result is equivalent for the marked moment and its limiting peak. The leaf-degree and root-attachment distributions concern different events; rephrasing one as a final-leaf indicator is not valid. The later catalogue date is not evidence for prior coverage.

evidence: The first exact candidate matches the marked closed form, but is later-dated. Both other exact candidates give the quarter-step aggregate covariance; they do not list covariances by birth label.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Equality of the sum cannot certify equality, or even the profile's sign pattern and maximizing label, term by term. Exact later overlap is explicitly preserved rather than treated as a search miss.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct claim is the exact final-leaf covariance and conditional mean at a specified birth rank, and hence the age profile. The aggregate formula is already covered. A later-dated Resultary record materially matches the marked theorem, but was not established to be earlier evidence.
residual_risks: Older full-text coverage of a marked-vertex specialization was not established for Dobrow–Fill, Zhang, or Altok–Işlak.
The identical mathematical profile in the later November 2 record is material overlap; precedence of any unpublished computations is unknown.

value.rationale: Final leaf status and total path length are natural recursive-tree observables. The birth-specific law resolves which age contributes most strongly and yields covariance for any chosen deterministic age window or weighting. In particular, it locates the strongest dependence at an interior age fraction rather than at either endpoint. Those are precise uses of the marked formula, not of the already known total covariance. A short deletion proof does not make the observed age-dependent invariant an automatic reading of the unmarked law.
residual_risks: The result concerns one conditional first moment, not a fluctuation theorem for an age-resolved process.
